title: Concept: XPath built by concatenation (java) — review required
description: In java, (?:xpath|evaluate)s*([^)]*+ embeds values in XPath text. Quote and axis syntax in input escapes the intended predicate. The remedy is variable binding via XPathVariableResolver.
applicability: java codebases querying XML with assembled paths; single-line lexical scope.
risk: XML disclosure and authentication bypass on XPath-based checks; HIGH severity.
